g.text: PujoPath is co-created by Soumik and Moumita to help discover Kolkata's pandals.

text.tspan: Directs user interface design, frontend architecture,
responsive layouts, user experience, visual consistency,
and interaction design, alongside research and curation
of Kolkata's historic Bonedi Bari traditions.
Directs backend & systems architecture, core application
logic, route optimization algorithms, offline-first transit

g.text: Share ideas, report bugs, or request features directly.
Explore pandals, plan walking routes, check metro connectivity.
